Package com.google.adk.plugins

Class SaveFilesAsArtifactsPlugin

java.lang.Object
com.google.adk.plugins.BasePlugin
com.google.adk.plugins.SaveFilesAsArtifactsPlugin
All Implemented Interfaces:
Plugin
public class SaveFilesAsArtifactsPlugin extends BasePlugin
Saves files attached to user messages as artifacts, replacing each with a placeholder that names the artifact so agents can load it later, such as with LoadArtifactsTool. Each file is saved under its display name, where a user: prefix shares it across the user's sessions, or under a generated name if it has no display name; files over 20 MB are replaced with an error note instead. Mirrors Python ADK's SaveFilesAsArtifactsPlugin.

      public io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Maybe<com.google.genai.types.Content> beforeAgentCallback(BaseAgent agent, CallbackContext callbackContext)
      Reports the versions saved from the user message on the event of the first agent to run, since a plugin cannot add actions to the user's own event.
      Parameters:
      agent - The agent that is about to run.
      callbackContext - The context for the agent invocation.
